content: This information is intended to provide general guidance and does not replace the personalized advice of your healthcare professional. Always seek complete and personalized guidance from your healthcare provider regarding this product and your health requirements. Adding plans allows you to compare the formulary status of this product with other drugs in the same therapeutic class. To access formulary information, you must first create a list of plans. This list will be saved and can be modified at any time. Adding plans enables you to make informed comparisons. Please note that the information provided is for general informational and educational purposes only. Individual plans may differ, and formulary details are subject to change. For the most accurate and up-to-date information, contact the relevant plan provider directly. When sending this information to a recipient, they will receive additional details and instructions on how to access the offer.
